messages:
Ashley Nguyen: quick question — following up on the RFC for quota reservoirs: are we comfortable with the 'graceful drain' approach where long-lived connections get a shrinking reservoir before being soft-evicted? thinking about fairness vs tail latency tradeoffs :thinking:
Matt Park: curious which signals we use to trigger shrink. current idea was rolling-window token burn + per-tenant concurrency high-water mark. if both exceed, start reservoir decay. keeps warm tenants first.
Kevin O'Leary: downside is bursty tenants that are usually quiet get hammered. alternative: probabilistic admission based on recent usage and a short probation window. cheaper to implement but harder to reason about p99.
Jessica Li: ran a quick sim on last week's traffic. if decay window = 60s and reservoir reduces by 20% per step, p99 latency improves 12% for heavy tenants, but cold-start tail for small tenants increases. attaching snippet of config we used in sim:
```
reservoir:
  initial_tokens: 1000
  decay_interval_s: 60
  decay_fraction: 0.2
  min_tokens: 50
```

Priya Sharma: rollout proposal: feature-flagged canary on Dedicated only, 24h metric collection, compare request success, p50/p95/p99 latency, and error-rate by tenant-size. if negative impact on small tenants >2% rollback.
Ashley Nguyen: @Priya SGTM. question about accounting — do we decrement tokens only on admitted requests or on queued requests too? Kevin?
Kevin O'Leary: only on admitted requests. queued requests should not consume reservoir until they start execution; otherwise we risk denying steady small requests behind a spike.
Matt Park: ops/infra note: this means queue length + queue wait time need to be surfaced as first-class telemetry in Console. don't want teams to be surprised when requests are queued but tokens unchanged.
Jessica Li: added dashboard mocks to the RFC doc. key metrics: reservoir_level, tokens_consumed/s, queued_requests, admission_rate_by_tier. also add a new alert: sustained reservoir < 10% for 3m.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag-reservoir v1 -> staging at 2025-07-06T18:34:00Z :rocket:
Priya Sharma: one more thought on abuse: combine reservoir decay with an abuse-score multiplier so high-abuse tenants decay faster. need to ensure false positives don't permanently punish a tenant. recommend exponential backoff caps and transparent TTLs.
Ashley Nguyen: ok action items: (1) Matt to add queue telemetry to Console mockups, (2) Jessica to include small-tenant sim scenarios and add acceptance criteria, (3) Kevin to write a short playbook for expected behavior during canary, (4) Priya to draft rollback thresholds and abuse multiplier limits. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up after staging run. thanks all :thumbsup:
Matt Park: on it.
Kevin O'Leary: will draft playbook today.
Jessica Li: working on sims now, will post results in the RFC doc.
Priya Sharma: drafting thresholds, will ping legal if we need tenant-notification language.
Ashley Nguyen: filing follow-up meeting. cheers.
